fact: After a meeting on 25 July 2025 of the economy minister, regulators (BCC, ARE, ARPTC) and consumer associations over bank and mobile money fees, the minister committed to check the prices charged and announced a multilingual chatbot for citizens to report fee abuses; the text calls the mobile money sector perceived as escaping rigorous control.
title: RDC : les régulateurs appelés à renforcer la protection des consommateurs face aux abus bancaires
